  FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?useType), STR(x3do:)))

SELECT DISTINCT ?parent ?field WHERE {
  ?field rdfs:subPropertyOf+ x3do:hasChild ; rdfs:range ?range ; rdfs:domain ?parent .
  x3do:Box rdfs:subClassOf* ?range .
  FILTER(isIRI(?range) && ?range != x3do:X3DNode)
} ORDER BY ?parent ?field
